Render one team organogram

Source: R/render.R
render_team_org.Rd

Creates an interactive organogram for a selected team. Managers from other teams are included when they are required to connect the hierarchy.

Usage

render_team_org(
  data,
  team,
  theme = theme_scotgov(),
  shaded_profession = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

Organisational relationship data.

team

A single team name.

theme

Theme returned by theme_scotgov().

shaded_profession

Either NULL or a single profession name. Nodes belonging to this profession receive a solid grade-coloured fill. If NULL, all occupied position nodes have a white fill.

show_legend

Logical. If TRUE, display the colour legend above the organogram.

Value

A DiagrammeR htmlwidget when show_legend is FALSE; otherwise, a browsable HTML component containing the legend and organogram.

Examples

path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "complex_org.csv",
  package = "organoR"
)

if (nzchar(path)) {
  org <- read_org_data(path)

  render_team_org(
    data = org,
    team = "Health",
    shaded_profession = "OR"
  )
}
